chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Aamir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fazalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu al-Abbas from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The least of what suffices for the Friday prayer is seven, or five being the least.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of people required for a valid Friday prayer in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the minimum quorum (jamāʿah) required for the validity of the Friday prayer, presenting a scholarly divergence between seven and five congregants. In Shia jurisprudence, this narration is often cited to discuss the conditions under which Jumu'ah transitions from a communal obligation to an individual one, with many scholars accepting five as the sufficient minimum for the prayer to be validly performed. The chain of transmission highlights the reliability of the Imami tradition in establishing these foundational legal parameters.
